paragraphs: Campminder makes management software for summer camps of every shape, from day camps to sleepaway programs and from twenty campers to two thousand. It is sold by role, with separate material pitched to camp owners and directors and to registrars and administrators.

Families register from their own devices, and the forms they fill out land in one organized place. Payments are collected and tracked inside the enrollment hub. A transportation planner lets staff drag and drop buses, routes, schedules and shuttles. Messaging tools pull camp data to send specific emails and texts to campers, parents, staff and alumni. An API distributes report data instantly to other departments. A companion app gives parents a photo feed that finds their child using facial recognition.

The company describes itself as a customer-centric business 22 years strong. Both product suites are tiered on the number of enrolled campers in the camp. Onboarding covers website integrations, historic data import and merchant account setup in fewer than three weeks. Camps across North America are described as using the platform to coordinate the logistics of running their programs.

quote.text: Campminder is made for all kinds of camps. We mean it.
